body: **Integration fix on agent-clis-sprint-1 (orchestrator).** `src/main/agents/adapters/acpProcess.test.ts` > "keeps only the tail of a long stderr" failed on every run on this Mac, already at the epic start commit 98df722. Its child script exited right after a 100 KB `console.error`, and stderr to a pipe is asynchronous on macOS (synchronous on Windows and Linux), so `THE-END` was never written. Commit a517f31 makes the child exit from the write callback. It is a test-only change and touches no production code. It would have failed the Definition of Done's `npm test` on this host, and the same test fails on `main`.
